thread.title: Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)’s To Showcase New Low Price MacBookAir and iPad Pro

author: Rick Anthony
title: Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)’s To Showcase New Low Price MacBookAir and iPad Pro
text:
October 22, 2018 Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)’s To Showcase New Low Price MacBookAir and iPad Pro
The users of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) were expecting the trillion dollar company, to just announce their long-awaited new low price MacBookAir and iPad Pro at the same time as the latest iPhone X series.
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)’s new smartphone has advertisements everywhere, and the internet started to speculate that they would have to wait, until the next year to get their hands on the new products. The Verge reports that Apple Inc. (AAPL) distributed media invites for an October 30th event, at the Brooklyn Academy of Music.
The techies believe that Apple will finally showcase their iPad Pro, and low-cost MacBook Air, the event’s tagline is “there’s more in the making”. The rumors claim that the new Apple’s iPad will convert to the USB-C charging port, that is used by the new Samsung’s and other Droid devices, and that will feature the 11 and 12.9-inch display sizes.
The new MacBook, is also speculated that it will be in the Air series, which will use a cheaper display screen to cut the costs. The heavily delayed AirPower charger and the new Mac Mini might also make an appearance at the upcoming event.
